page: Microsoft Azure M24ds_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MDSMediumMemoryv3 family. Built on the x86_64 architecture with Intel processors, it operates under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is configured with 24 dedicated vCPUs and 480.0 GB of system memory, delivering a high memory-to-core ratio of 20.0 GB per vCPU.

This server includes 410 GB of local SSD storage and supports premium storage configurations for high-throughput disk operations. It does not feature integrated GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource-density perspective, the M24ds_v3 offers a high volume of memory relative to compute cores, making it highly efficient for workloads where RAM capacity is the primary constraint. Tradeoffs include the lack of hardware acceleration and a moderate CPU count relative to the massive memory footprint. It is suited for large in-memory databases, enterprise relational databases, and memory-intensive data processing applications.
